scope: Guan Di Temple on Jalan Tun H.S. Lee in February 2007, including the ornate forecourt gateway, green tiled roof, orange-red street frontage, covered main hall and attached rear mass.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The Kwong Siew Association records the temple at 168 Jalan Tun H.S. Lee and the roof restoration completed after 1994.
The association records the ancestral-hall form and street-front shrine to Guan Di.
The association documents a two-storey school building behind the temple.
